description: This Java class `ReadableOrderProductDownload` represents a downloadable product associated with an order, containing properties such as order ID, product name, download URL, file name, expiry days, and download count.

classes.name: ReadableOrderProductDownload
classes.description: A Serializable Java entity class extending `Entity`, representing the downloadable details of a product in an order.

methods.name: getDownloadExpiryDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days before the download expires.

methods.name: setDownloadExpiryDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days before the download expires.

methods.name: getDownloadCount
methods.description: Returns the number of times the download has been accessed.

methods.name: setDownloadCount
methods.description: Sets the number of times the download has been accessed.

methods.name: getProductName
methods.description: Returns the name of the product.

methods.name: setProductName
methods.description: Sets the name of the product.

methods.name: getDownloadUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for downloading the product.

methods.name: setDownloadUrl
methods.description: Sets the URL for downloading the product.

methods.name: getOrderId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the order.

methods.name: setOrderId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the order.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with the download.

methods.name: setFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename associated with the download.
